breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. While it correctly included the instruction to use "Sutherland transport properties", it also included the user's contradictory and physically incorrect instruction: "Set the fluid viscosity to zero everywhere to represent an inviscid flame." A diffusion flame cannot be inviscid, and these two instructions are mutually exclusive.
